Context span 4989-5005 (lemma-is-limit statement): for K with locally quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves satisfying the flat base change property there is a distinguished triangle K -> prod tau_{>= -n} K -> prod tau_{>= -n} K -> K[1], i.e., K is the derived limit of its canonical truncations; the delivered card L48295 (sum-is-product) gives direct sum = product in D_QCoh for such K

Context span 5041-5057: since a quasi-coherent module is locally quasi-coherent with the flat base change property (Sheaves on Stacks, quasi-coherent) we get E = prod over m >= 0 of O_X[m]; since cohomology commutes with limits, Rf_*E = prod over m >= 0 of (direct sum over n >= 0 of O_S[m-n]); the degree-0 cohomology sheaf is an infinite product of copies of O_S, which is not even locally quasi-coherent, so this complex is not an object of D_QCoh(O_S)
core_obligations: E = direct sum O_X[m] lies in D_QCoh(O_X) (context)
By lemma-is-limit (context statement) together with the delivered sum-is-product card, E = product O_X[m] in D(O_X)
Rf_*E = product over m of (direct sum over n of O_S[m-n]) (context: cohomology commutes with limits)

The degree-0 cohomology sheaf of Rf_*E is the infinite product of copies of O_S, not locally quasi-coherent (context), so Rf_*E is not in D_QCoh(O_S); hence Rf_* does not preserve D_QCoh although f is quasi-compact and quasi-separated
